annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence in the Healthcare (Policy DHA/HISHD/PP-09)
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence in the Healthcare (Policy DHA/HISHD/PP-09)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dubai Health Authority (DHA), Health Informatics & Smart Health Department
annotation.summary_en: Dubai Health Authority policy setting regulatory and ethical requirements for AI solutions in healthcare in Dubai. It covers fairness, accountability, transparency, privacy, security and minimum requirements for AI tools, including compliance with UAE health ICT law, certification, auditable validation, graceful degradation and monitoring.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to DHA-licensed facilities, AI developers using Dubai data, insurers, pharma and researchers.
AI solutions must be fair, bias-free and ethically aligned with UAE and Dubai law.
Accountability for AI outcomes must be agreed among designers, developers, operators and end users.
AI tools must comply with the UAE ICT Health Law, medical liability rules and cybersecurity standards.
AI tools need certification, auditable validation, misuse prevention, clinical performance monitoring and graceful degradation.
